contract_law: Machine-specific local paths are NEVER part of the contract. What is frozen here is the LOGICAL layout and the authority relationship between layers. A storage root is movable: the G4-11 restore and the G4-13 path-independence proofs both relocate the whole tree and obtain identical public evidence views.

identity_separation.content_id: blob_sha256 — the 64-character source SHA-256 of the exact provider bytes
identity_separation.storage_object_key: portable, backend-neutral, slash-separated key under a root
identity_separation.resolved_local_path: machine-specific root + object key; derived, never canonical
identity_separation.note: Absolute workstation paths are never evidence identity (storage.paths module law).

logical_layers.purpose: Exact, immutable, content-addressed provider source bytes.
logical_layers.authority: AUTHORITATIVE for source bytes. The wrapper suffix is metadata only; the source content id is identical for both encodings.
logical_layers.mutability: Write-once. A committed object can never be replaced through a public API.
logical_layers.deletion_authority: None automatic. Retention is a separate, explicitly invoked policy.

logical_layers.purpose: Typed records describing T0 evidence: blob metadata, acquisitions, partition manifests, current pointers, revisions, jobs, transitions, quota and recovery state.
logical_layers.object_key_shape: catalogs/** (per-record JSON fragments published atomically, plus current-pointer files)
logical_layers.authority: AUTHORITATIVE for evidence identity, acquisition provenance, manifest history and the revision chain.
properties: Append-only per record; a partition keeps every historical manifest version.
The current pointer is advanced only after its manifest is durable.
CAS on (manifest_id, version); divergence raises a typed conflict, never a silent retry.

logical_layers.purpose: Parsed/derived projections committed from T0A, with their schemas, contexts and lineage.
logical_layers.object_key_shape: projections/** plus catalogs/manifests/projections, projection_context, projection_lineage, projection_schemas
logical_layers.authority: SUBORDINATE. A projection may never be referenced by a manifest unless its lineage resolves completely to existing T0A blob and acquisition evidence.
properties: T0B never supersedes T0A; deleting T0B loses derived data only.
The projection schema descriptor exposes provider-native fields as name/type/nullable and carries NO unit metadata (see BLOC_04_I16_BLOC4_READINESS.json).

logical_layers.purpose: Per-source-key revision segments, observations and provider declarations.
logical_layers.authority: AUTHORITATIVE for 'same source, different bytes' history. Reconstructing a revision list never re-derives identity from descriptors; it replays durable acquisitions.
logical_layers.public_surface_note: SourceRevisionRegistry and RevisionSourceIdentityV1 are not in the package __all__; downstream consumers read revision state through the public RawEvidenceResult.revision_state.

logical_layers.purpose: Bloc 3 job state and its transition log, including the resume checkpoint.
logical_layers.authority: DERIVED STATE, gated. A checkpoint advance re-proves exact acquisition, physically verified blob and manifest/acquisition source identity from the repositories themselves before it is recorded.
logical_layers.prohibited: No external job-state manipulation; the job chain may only advance through the durable handoff.

logical_layers.purpose: Detected integrity failures and registered recovery actions.
logical_layers.authority: Detection only. A quarantined object is recorded, never silently repaired.
properties: Absent object is not corruption; they are distinct states.

logical_layers.purpose: Derived discovery index over the durable records, for fast enumeration.
logical_layers.object_key_shape: a single catalog file outside the durable tree
logical_layers.authority: DERIVED AND DISPOSABLE. Deleting it loses no durable truth; it is rebuilt from the manifest and projection files on an empty catalog. Corrupting a durable source makes the rebuild fail loudly rather than emit a quiet catalog.
logical_layers.prohibited: It must never become the unique source of truth.

logical_layers.purpose: Operational metadata mirror: registry, readiness, jobs, blob/acquisition/manifest metadata, quota and recovery summaries.
logical_layers.authority: OPERATIONAL MIRROR AND STATE ONLY. It is reconstructible from the durable tree, and dropping it loses no T0 evidence.
logical_layers.prohibited: No raw byte payload column or table, no secret-bearing metadata, no resume-token authority, and no bulk raw storage.

logical_layers.purpose: Portable, self-verifying evidence packs containing T0A bytes, T0B, manifests, revisions, schemas, lineage and the query specification.
logical_layers.object_key_shape: a pack root outside the source tree, with a manifest listing every object by role and checksum
logical_layers.authority: DERIVED PORTABLE COPY. Verified completely before any destination mutation; restored into an EMPTY root through a staging tree promoted atomically.
properties: No source-root filesystem assumption: a pack can be exported from one root and restored under an unrelated one.
Unlisted files in a pack are refused; there is no best-effort recovery.

authority_relationships.content_identity: T0A bytes define content identity; nothing else may claim to.
authority_relationships.evidence_identity: The T0A metadata catalog is authoritative for identity and history.
authority_relationships.derived_data: T0B, DuckDB and PostgreSQL are all subordinate to T0A and all reconstructible from it.
authority_relationships.checkpoint: Job checkpoints are derived state and may only advance on re-proven durable truth.
authority_relationships.backup: Export packs are verified copies, never a new authority.
authority_relationships.removal: Deleting DuckDB, PostgreSQL or T0B loses derived state only. Deleting T0A is a loss of truth and is never automatic.
